steps.text: Hit the white targets for 50 points. The red targets award Mystery Score.
The lower outside rollovers score 5 points, or 50 when lit. The inner lower rollovers score 10 when lit.

checkBeforePlay: A tilt disqualifies the current player. Check the installed card for ball count and replay awards.
